title: Distance covered in each of four equal times by a ball rolling from rest
description: Bar chart of the distance a ball rolling from rest down an inclined plane covers in each of four successive equal times: 1, 3, 5 and 7 units, the odd numbers, so that the total from rest is 1, 4, 9 and 16. Source: Galileo, Two New Sciences (1638), Third Day, Corollary I, in the translation of Henry Crew and Alfonso de Salvio (1914).
heading: DISTANCE IN EACH EQUAL TIME · FROM REST
